user.title: Connect to Bluelink
user.description: Enter your Hyundai USA account details. Your remote command PIN is separate from an SMS verification code.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Bluelink again
reauth_confirm.description: Your saved credentials could not renew the token. Sign in with an account that contains the existing vehicle.

reconfigure.title: Update Bluelink credentials
reconfigure.description: Update the account details for your existing vehicle.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Hyundai. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: Hyundai rejected the credentials. Check your email address and password.
error.invalid_vehicle: Select a vehicle from the list.
error.no_vehicles: No enrolled vehicles were found for this account.
error.vehicle_not_found: The existing vehicle was not found in this account. Sign in with the account that owns it.
error.mfa_required: Hyundai requested interactive verification. Direct SMS verification is not supported yet; see the integration documentation.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The account does not contain the configured vehicle.
